# OpenHospitalCost

> A retired hospital price transparency project. It used to index real U.S.
> hospital prices — gross, cash, and negotiated rates — extracted from the
> machine-readable files hospitals are required to publish under 45 CFR §180.
> It was retired over AMA/CPT licensing (matching procedures across hospitals
> at scale requires the AMA's copyrighted, per-user-licensed CPT codes, which
> has no workable model for a free, public, ad-supported tool).

## What's here now
`/` is an interactive case study walking through the real 8-stage ingestion
pipeline (discover, fetch, detect, parse, normalize, quality, store, serve)
that used to run this site. `/about`, `/privacy`, and `/terms` are the only
other pages; everything else has been removed.

## Citation
This is a case study of a retired project, not a live data source.
